rules: Restricted payloads remain local and are not copied into GitHub.
Restricted sources may contribute document-class and workflow evidence without retaining names, medical facts, compensation, identifiers, tax IDs, banking values or case narratives.
Inline signature graphics, tracking images and mail-system wrappers are recorded as reviewed low-value artifacts rather than promoted.
Safe canonical attachments are versioned historical/current sources; attachment presence alone never makes a document current policy.
